objective: Normalize official listing, regulatory no-trading, resumption, delisting and reorganization events into one deterministic symbol-session lifecycle before historical coverage classification.

TPEX.source: TPEX official delisted-company registry / underlying machine response to be pinned
TPEX official bulletin structured source or pinned bulletin machine index

intervalSemantics.stopResume: A no-trading interval is [stopDate,resumeDate). The stopDate is excluded from expected price rows; resumeDate is again eligible if the security is still a member.
intervalSemantics.delisting: Delisting effective date is an exclusive membership boundary. The old symbol is not expected to have a daily price row on the delisting effective date unless an official source explicitly states that trading occurs that date.
intervalSemantics.listing: Listing/trading start date is an inclusive membership boundary.
intervalSemantics.shareConversion: If share conversion causes stop trading before delisting, represent both [stopDate,delistingDate) no-trading interval and membership termination at delistingDate. Do not fabricate a bar or extend the old symbol after the conversion boundary.
intervalSemantics.openEndedStop: If no resume date exists, end the no-trading interval at the earliest proven delisting/migration-out boundary; otherwise keep it open through verification coverage and do not infer resumption.
intervalSemantics.overlap: Union overlapping no-trading intervals after semantic normalization. Never subtract the same symbol-session twice.

dedupeIdentity.exactDuplicate: collapse only when canonical event payload is identical
dedupeIdentity.conflictingDuplicate: retain both source claims and emit EVENT_BOUNDARY_CONFLICT

coverageIntegration.after: coverage receives canonical lifecycle state per market|symbol|date or normalized interval set plus membership boundaries
coverageIntegration.invariant: A1 storage/source reconciliation is unchanged. Lifecycle classification may change the expected denominator or gap reason, never mutate cold OHLCV.

acceptanceCases.rule: share-conversion stop 2024-08-21 plus delisting 2024-09-02 => [2024-08-21,2024-09-02) no-trading and old-symbol membership ends 2024-09-02

indicatorSemantics.bollinger: Window population counts valid eligible trading observations, not calendar dates and not fabricated rows across official no-trading intervals.
indicatorSemantics.adx: Recursive state may consume only certified observation chronology. No TR/DM is synthesized for official no-trading intervals; resume bridging/restart remains a separate certified continuity rule.
